name.en-US: The Religion of the Plain Man

description.en-US: Benson's short apologetic of 1906 for the ordinary English reader: through the questions of an imagined plain man, John, it considers English religion, the characteristics of the Roman Church, the Petrine claims, development, infallibility, intellect, emotion and faith, and what a convert exchanges, with appendices on St Peter in Scripture and the primitive papalists.
description.pt-BR: A breve apologética de Benson (1906) para o leitor inglês comum: a partir das perguntas de um homem simples imaginado, John, trata da religião inglesa, das características da Igreja Romana, das pretensões de Pedro, do desenvolvimento, da infalibilidade, de intelecto, emoção e fé, e do que um convertido troca, com apêndices sobre São Pedro na Escritura e os primitivos papalistas.

sources.edition: The Religion of the Plain Man (London: Burns & Oates, 1906), Internet Archive full-text OCR (religionplainman00bensuoft).
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Mgr. Robert Hugh Benson died in 1914 and the edition is of 1906, so the text is public domain.
